scene_description: Light gray wood-grain desk along a wall with a power-outlet strip at its back edge. A charger block is plugged into the outlet strip at the back edge, and a whiteboard eraser stands on its end, leaning against the charger. Front is the edge away from the wall.

targets.name: whiteboard eraser
targets.description: Gray felt whiteboard eraser standing on its short end at the back of the desk, leaning against the plugged-in charger.
targets.orientation: leaning, standing on its end against the charger
targets.clearance_notes: Front and sides are open, but it is balanced on its end and may tip.

candidate_improvements.description: Lay the eraser flat on the desk.
Move the eraser approximately 15 cm toward the front, away from the strip.

targets.name: charger block
targets.description: Small black charger block plugged into the outlet strip along the back edge, with the whiteboard eraser leaning on its front.
targets.orientation: upright, plugged into the outlet strip
nearby_obstacles: Whiteboard eraser leaning on its front
Outlet strip it is plugged into
targets.clearance_notes: The eraser covers most of its front; it is held in the outlet at the very back.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the eraser away from the charger, then unplug the charger.

targets.other_notes: Plugged in; must be unplugged before it is moved.

source: Staged permutation of S0035 and S0037, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
